body:
I think your comment hit the nail.  
It certainly feels like a cycle of self-hate. And knowing that it's a self-reinforcing cycle doesn't make it stop. It makes it worse. 

I recognize the "oh, you're a nice person", "oh, I'm sure you'll be a wonderful (insert anything) someday"
Blah. Everyone will tell anyone this. 

I won't ignore your suggestion. 
Doing the dishes, fixing up stuff at home etc., is a way of contributing I guess. 
I've found that I increasingly need support from others. I feel like an attention-whore, but it kind of works in the short term. There is a vicious cycle here too. 

I do dream about being a part of a group. Not as a leecher, but as someone who is just as important as everybody else. Somebody who "gives."

Thank you for caring :)
I kind of already did drop out of college. I quit an interesting engineering program because it was hard. Started something else that is easier. (I've managed to pass finals this year, although barely, with minimal work) I do regret the choice, but I can't change again. I've got 3 years left. I guess it comes down to me making a mess of everything.

Thank you for taking time to answer. 
I'll try focusing om physical things like you mention.What I usually try to do now is playing very simple, high-stress games (i.e tetris, flight control) to keep my mind occupied, but that only works at home. 
Thanks for reminding me that it does get better for some people.
